create_gpu_model_runner: create a GPUModelRunner instance with VllmConfig and torch device to run LLM inference on GPU
run_execute_model: run execute_model on GPUModelRunner with SchedulerOutput to perform one inference step and return ModelRunnerOutput
load_model_weights: load model weights onto GPU via GPUModelRunner.load_model using VllmConfig and the model loader
capture_cuda_graphs: capture CUDA graphs for GPUModelRunner via capture_model to accelerate repeated inference batches
sample_next_tokens: sample next tokens from GPUModelRunner via sample_tokens using logits and speculative decoding metadata
initialize_kv_cache: initialize KV cache memory on GPU via GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache with KVCacheConfig and kernel block sizes
reload_model_weights: reload model weights in-place on GPUModelRunner via reload_weights from a weights iterator or disk path
profile_inference_memory: profile inference memory and CUDA graph requirements via GPUModelRunner.profile_run and profile_cudagraph_memory
